//: Lighthouse assertions for CI. Split deliberately into gates and signals.
This file exists because the workflow previously asserted everything as
'warn' AND appended '|| true' AND set continue-on-error — three separate
ways of guaranteeing the job could never fail. It looked like a quality
gate on the PR and enforced nothing.
Accessibility, SEO and best-practices are deterministic: they score the
rendered markup, not the runner's mood. Those are hard gates. Minimums
are set below the measured floor (2026-08-08: a11y 0.94-0.95, seo 1.00,
run-to-run variance. Raise them as the scores improve.
Performance genuinely fluctuates on shared CI runners — it measured
0.67-0.84 across the same pages in one sitting. Hard-failing on that
produces flaky red builds, and a CI check people learn to ignore is how
this repo accumulated its dead gates in the first place. It stays a
warning: reported on every run, blocking on none.
SEO is a hard gate rather than a nicety because organic and AI-answer
traffic is a primary acquisition channel for this product.
